verdict.rationale: GlitchTip has two noise controls of its own. Alert rules can fire based on error frequency (docs-29), and individual issues can be ignored (update_issue: resolve, unresolve, or ignore, docs-37). That only touches the mute/ignore part of the story. The spike item (docs-48) is about on-demand billing that keeps collecting events past the plan, which is not spike protection. The 1% sampling setting (tracesSampleRate) is configured in the client SDK for performance transactions, not a per-key rate limit in GlitchTip. Missing for 10: spike protection, per-key/DSN rate limits, rule-based mute/snooze (e.g. ignore until N events or for a time window), and any hands-on corroboration of alert-noise reduction.
